definitions.explanation: The early part of the day.

examples.english: To wake up in the morning.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}かった→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{六時|ろくじ}→六時：10982_rokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きています→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I get up at six o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{朝|あさ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often skip breakfast because I don't have time in the morning.

notes:
{朝|あさ} refers to the morning, roughly from dawn until late morning.

TIMES OF DAY:
- {朝|あさ}: morning
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: noon, daytime
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: evening (before dark)
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: night

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧: breakfast (formal)
- {朝|あさ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: breakfast (casual)
- ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧: every morning
- ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧: this morning
- ⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧: morning sun, sunrise
- ⟦{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}→朝寝坊：02516_asanebou⟧: oversleeping, late riser

COMMON PATTERNS:
Like other time words, {朝|あさ} can be used without a particle:
- {朝|あさ}⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (wake up in the morning)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {朝|あさ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from morning till night
- {朝|あさ}⟦イチ→イチ：noentry⟧: first thing in the morning (casual)
